children: Global Business Travel Group finalized a new senior secured first-lien financing concurrent with its merger closing, consisting of a $1.5 billion term loan drawn at closing and a $250 million undrawn revolving facility. At the same time, the company repaid and terminated its prior Morgan Stanley-led credit agreement. The refinancing is intended to optimize liquidity and streamline the capital structure after the transaction.
: Senior secured first-lien term loan and revolving credit facilities
: JPMorgan Chase, as administrative and collateral agent, and other lenders
: Refinance debt and fund operations following merger close
: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement and related credit commitments
: Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, as administrative and collateral agent, and other lenders
: Replaced by new first-lien credit facilities at closing
